name: html-autofit-grid-carries-zero-gap
description: An auto-fit grid with an explicit unitless gap:0 must carry blockGap '0' onto the native grid group; otherwise WordPress substitutes the theme's default block gap for a grid the author declared gapless.

source_reference.notes: Companion to html-autofit-grid-carries-gap-and-background: the unitless-zero form of the gap declaration failed the original number+unit pattern, so gapless card walls rendered with the theme default gap.

legacy_comparison.reason: Covers current PHP transformer layout classification behavior; no downstream legacy comparison.
